$comment: Source of truth for automatic model-role selection (extensions/model-tiers.ts). Tiers: worker = Sonnet-class implementation workers and the fast slot; base = Opus-class main session; deep = Fable-class planning, hardest work and advisor; light = Haiku-class session titles only. Each role runs on the newest available model of its tier at that model's benchmark sweet spot plus `step` levels (or a fixed `effort`). A newer model is adopted only after its sweet spot is recorded here (model_tiers tool, action record). Roles in pinnedRoles are never touched.
